analyzed_vuln.description: SSA type inference for ZEND_INIT_ARRAY/ZEND_ADD_ARRAY_ELEMENT can violate the optimizer's array-type invariant. In the ZEND_ARRAY_ELEMENT_REF branch, it unconditionally ORs MAY_BE_ARRAY_OF_ANY|MAY_BE_ARRAY_OF_REF into the result after assign_dim_array_result_type() has deliberately omitted array key bits for an empty/unreachable value type or an invalid key type. This leaves MAY_BE_ARRAY_OF_ANY set without MAY_BE_ARRAY_KEY_ANY. The malformed var_info reaches the pre-DFA ssa_verify_integrity() check, which reports the key/value mismatch and aborts at ssa_integrity.c:401. The fix belongs in the array-element inference case (around lines 3140-3155), not in the verifier.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A fuzzed PHP script must compile an array literal/add-element-by-reference opcode (ZEND_ARRAY_ELEMENT_REF) for which inference cannot add a valid key/value pair—most notably an element in optimizer-unreachable code with an empty inferred value type, or an element whose inferred key type is illegal for arrays. The fuzzer compiles the script through opcache; zend_dfa_analyze_op_array builds SSA, _zend_update_type_info creates the one-sided array metadata, and zend_dfa_optimize_op_array immediately invokes the debug SSA integrity verifier and aborts.
